title: This Week in Marketing Ep. 2: Recency hacks, review interlinking, and the DTC bust
summary: Jacky Chou and James De Lacey trade niche-site and brand tactics: refresh publish dates to jump rankings, interlink a "best X" roundup with individual product reviews, and use YouTube embeds as a ranking flywheel. They also cover the Made.com collapse as a warning on burn rate after the Covid boom, and expected pain for DTC and affiliate revenue.

principles.text: Refresh blog post publish dates every 1-2 months to get a recency ranking jump, then optimize content after the jump.
principles.quote: I typically do it once a month or once every two months. And I change the publish date to most recent date for my blog posts.

principles.text: On a newly bought site, restyle it and set all posts to the most recent date to trigger an initial ranking jump.
principles.quote: I immediately change it to generate press theme, slap on a nice theme, design it nicely, and change all blog posts to most recent date. And that typically gives it a jump.

principles.text: Recency matters most in tech niches; even changing only the date, without content edits, can work.
principles.quote: I don't even change any content. You just changed the date. Yeah. And that pops up immediately. It's, it works extremely well for tech niches because tech's all about recency.

principles.text: Embed long-form YouTube videos in ranking pages: views feed rankings both ways, creating a self-fulfilling flywheel.
principles.quote: you get organic views and if you embed. In your website that already ranks Yeah. Pushes more views and the more views it gets, it ranks higher on YouTube

principles.text: Over-expanding on a pandemic demand spike without cutting burn when it fades is fatal (Made.com sold for $3M after raising ~$135M).
principles.quote: their burn rate was way too high. And now they've gone bankrupt.

principles.text: Expect a consumer slowdown to trickle down to niche sites via ad and affiliate budgets; consider selling some sites and holding the best.
principles.quote: I think I'll try to offload some niche sites in January just for whatever multiples I can. And hold the big ones for a long time.
